parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the CEN instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the attached network instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the attached network instance is created.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the route table of the attached network instance.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the attached network instance.

Set the value to **VPC**, which indicates a virtual private cloud (VPC).

parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the route that you want to withdraw.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn withdraw-published-route-entries --cen-id cen-sxjfjkjfkjfiein0000 --child-instance-id vpc-rj9gt5nll27onu70000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --child-instance-route-table-id vtb-bp174d1gje79u1g4t0000 --destination-cidr-block 172.16.1.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
